class.name: IfcMotorConnectionType
class.brief_description: The energy conversion device type IfcMotorConnectionType defines commonly shared information for occurrences of motor connections. members.member: Identifies the predefined types of motor connection from which the type required may be set. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.
